title: MBESO2D: An Open MATLAB Implementation of Two-Dimensional Multi-Material BESO
description: A reproducible MATLAB implementation of stress-based two-dimensional multi-material bi-directional evolutionary structural optimization, including retained-solid regions, line loads, self-weight, validation scripts, and benchmark examples.
